rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent dominant mass with a recognizable carved condition rather than a pile of unrelated pieces. The four views agree enough to confirm a single primary object, and the top/oblique views show a legible open slot/court that helps satisfy the neighborhood-living requirement for an active ground threshold. The road frontage edge is not sealed; the mass appears to respond with an open seam and undercut-like void logic, which is the right semantic direction for this program. The main weakness is section clarity: the form is somewhat pyramidal/stepped and the void is more interiorized than explicitly public, so the section-program relationship is only moderate. It still supports the brief plausibly, but it is not a fully confident neighborhood-building section yet.
